name: Shim Eun-kyung
bio: Shim Eun-kyung (심은경) is a South Korean actress. Born on May 31, 1994, she has starred in a number of films and television dramas, notably the blockbusters Sunny (2011), Masquerade (2012), and Miss Granny (2014). She also starred in the Japanese film The Journalist (2019) which earned her the Japanese Academy Award for Best Actress, a first for any Korean.
